name: Kinetic Strike
text: A blow is only half of what you hit with; the other half is the ground you just covered. When you hit with a melee attack after moving at least 10ft this turn, spend 1 Momentum to add one Agility Die to that attack's Impact Roll.

name: Gathering Speed
text: You do not begin a fight fast. You become fast while it lasts. The first time on each of your turns that you move at least 20ft, you gain 1 Momentum. Movement forced on you by another creature builds nothing — only ground you chose to cover.

name: Phase Step
text: You step through the gap between one moment and the next. For 1 AP and 1 Momentum, move up to 20ft to an unoccupied space you can see, passing through creatures and solid objects on the way. This movement provokes no Opportunity Attacks.

name: Afterimage
text: What the blow finds is the shape you left behind. As a Reaction when an attack hits you, if you have moved at least 20ft since the start of your last turn, spend 2 Momentum and that attack becomes a Glancing Blow.

name: Cutting Slide
text: You go low, take the legs, and are gone before they land. For 1 AP and 1 Agility Point, move up to 15ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks and make one melee attack against an enemy you pass. On a hit, that enemy is Slowed by 15ft until the end of its next turn.

name: Collision Course
text: The distance between you and a target is fuel you have not spent yet. For 1 AP and 1 Momentum, move up to your Base Speed in a straight line toward an enemy and make one melee attack against it at the end of that movement. If you covered at least 20ft, add one Agility Die to the Impact Roll.

name: Mercurial Recovery
text: Your body closes its wounds at the pace you set for it. The first time on each of your turns that you move at least 20ft, you may spend 1 Momentum to roll your Vigor Die and regain that many Hit Points.

name: Quicksilver Rush
text: Requires any two Velocity Majors. You become a line drawn through the formation, and everything on it is behind you before it falls. For 1 AP, 2 Momentum, and 1 Agility Point, move up to your Base Speed in a straight line through enemy spaces, provoking no Opportunity Attacks, and make one melee attack against each enemy you pass through. Every enemy you strike has its Agility Defense Sundered by 1 until the end of your next turn, on a Glancing Blow as readily as on a hit.

name: The Juggernaut
text: You have outrun every limit that holds other people in place. You cannot be Slowed, Grappled, or knocked Prone, and Difficult Terrain costs you nothing. Once per combat, when you hit with a melee attack after moving at least 20ft that turn, spend up to 3 Momentum and 2 Agility Points to add one Agility Die to that Impact Roll for each Momentum spent. The target is hurled 20ft directly away from you and must succeed on a Vigor Save or be knocked Prone.
